excerpt.en: Self-publishing book printing starts at 1 copy with no minimum order. This guide compares five binding formats, explains the digital-to-offset break at 100 copies, and publishes the per-copy reference ladder from 100 to 10,000 copies.

content.en:
Self-publishing printing starts at 1 copy, no minimum order. Digital runs carry no plate fee; 100+ copies turn to offset.

Quick Answer: What is the minimum order for a book?

1 copy, no minimum order: the category page runs digital printing, which needs no plate.

Quick Answer: When does offset beat digital?

At 100+ copies, which the category page recommends for offset. Below that, digital costs more per copy but drops the plate fee.

Quick Answer: How do I check quality before a full run?

Order one copy: a digital proof is ready within 1 hour of file submission on the perfect bound line.

Know your page count? Send your specs to ZprintPro on WhatsApp for a per-copy quote at 100 and 1,000 copies.

Can you print a self-published book from 1 copy?

Yes. The books category page states a 1 copy minimum on digital printing and names it for self-publishing and limited art editions. Before a crowdfunding launch, order one copy, photograph it, then print the run.

How is self-publishing book printing priced?

Books are quoted per copy. Four specifications set the band: page count, trim size, interior stock and binding. Published bands run HK$16-80 per copy for perfect bound books, HK$40-240 for hardcover books, HK$6-32 for saddle stitch booklets, HK$8-40 for spiral notebooks and HK$2.8-1000 for catalog printing.

The product pages name an HP Indigo 15K B2 digital line and a Heidelberg offset press line. Offset needs plates, so make-ready only pays back over a longer run. Lead times: digital 2-3 days, offset 5-7 days, hardcover 7-10 days. DHL worldwide shipping is 2-4 days, free on US orders over $99.

Which binding should you choose for your book?

Six binding methods are listed on the category page; these five have a product page.

BindingBest forPages
Perfect boundNovels and reports48-400
HardcoverKeepsakes and yearbooksBy page count
Saddle stitchZines and programmes8-64
Wire-o and spiralWorkbooks and manualsBy page count
CatalogLookbooks and portfoliosBy page count

Perfect bound and hardcover do not lie flat, so artwork crossing the spine loses a few millimetres into the gutter; saddle stitch and wire-o open flat, which suits a slim small-batch booklet.

What does the price ladder look like from 100 to 10,000 copies?

The perfect bound product page publishes a reference ladder for A5 (148 x 210 mm), 4+32pp, PUR perfect binding.

Unit price falls from US$2.08 at 100 copies to US$0.36 at 1,000, then flattens, and the page flags the 10,000-copy tier as best value. That points to a two-step release, digital for backers then offset once demand is proven, and a quote at two run sizes shows the spread.

Which paper and cover stocks hold up in the mail?

Stocks are listed per title in the product data. Perfect bound and catalog work use 157g-200g art paper inside with a 200g-250g laminated cover; hardcover replaces it with 2.5mm gray board, foil or ribbon; saddle stitch runs on 128g-157g book paper. Matte lamination shows handling marks, gloss shows scratches. Picture-led titles follow the same logic in the children's picture book guide.

Low MOQ, fast samples, transparent factory

Low MOQ, fast samples and a transparent factory are the three factors an author is really buying, and each is checkable before ordering.

Low MOQ. The minimum is 1 copy on digital printing with no minimum order, so a proof copy and a limited signed edition come from one file. The category page recommends 100+ copies for offset and lists volume discounts at 500, 1,000 and 5,000 copies, while the product pages for the offset-oriented titles carry a structured minimum of 100 pieces. Ask which applies to your specification.

Fast samples. A digital proof is ready within 1 hour of file submission on the perfect bound line, and the category page quotes a free design proof within 4 hours.

Transparent factory. The facility is described as ISO 9001 and FSC certified, and the book product pages name ICC color management with press-side proofing. The category page also notes an InDesign typesetting team. The print inquiry index lists the specification fields a factory needs before files are sent.

Frequently asked questions about self-publishing printing

Q1: Is there really no minimum order?
A: The category page states a 1 copy minimum on digital printing with no minimum order, while the product pages for the offset-oriented titles list 100 pieces.

Q2: What does it cost to print 100 paperback copies?
A: For the published A5, 4+32pp PUR perfect bound reference specification, the product page lists US$2.08 per copy at 100 copies, a batch total of US$207.94.

Q3: Can I get a sample before ordering a full run?
A: Yes. Because the minimum is 1 copy, a single sample can be ordered from the same file, and the category page quotes a free design proof within 4 hours.

Q4: How long does printing and delivery take?
A: Digital at 2-3 days, offset at 5-7 days and hardcover at 7-10 days, per the category page. DHL worldwide shipping is 2-4 days, free on US orders over $99.
